Vertex 7 (factors 3,5,10) misses direction 40; vertex 10 (factors 5,7,8) also misses direction 40; vertex 3 (factors 1,4,6) misses direction 16; vertices 1,4,5,6,8,9 miss direction 16 as well. Hence the literal incidence computation yields exactly {2}.
